results.description: “The public is going to have a harder and harder time accessing these benefits,” union official said.

results.title: More states, including Oklahoma, banning marriage for those under 18
results.description: After authorities rescued 16 children last month who had been confined to a single room in a home in rural Ohio, attention turned to their mother, who had been 15 and pregnant when she married their father.
